lane_compliance.note: ONLY a new SelectionGizmoBar.cs was added. All reads are READ-ONLY. (BuildManager.cs M + BarricadeEntity.cs in git status belong to the parallel B4 lane, NOT this lane.)

design.bootstrap: [RuntimeInitializeOnLoadMethod(AfterSceneLoad)] -> hidden DontDestroyOnLoad GO '~SelectionGizmoBar' + FindFirstObjectByType idempotency guard, EXACTLY like AlertStackUI/HotkeyCheatSheet.

design.selection_read: READ-ONLY poll each frame (singleton-subscriber pattern, NOT OnEnable subscribe): MarqueeSelector.CurrentMultiSelection / .HasMultiSelection FIRST, else ClickSelector.CurrentSelection. Skips dead pawns.
design.draft_command: Draft/Undraft button calls PawnEntity.SetDrafted(!IsDrafted) — the EXACT same public API ClickSelector's R-key uses (ClickSelector.Update line ~59). Multi-select applies the first pawn's target state to all selected. NO new draft behavior.
design.cancel_command: Cancel/Deselect button calls PawnEntity.SetSelected(false) on selected pawns (same minimal read-only clear MarqueeSelector uses) then hides bar; selectors re-evaluate on next click.
design.hide_when_empty: Update hides the bar (SetActive(false)) whenever the collected selection is empty.
design.click_sfx: Single AudioBank.PlaySelect() on discrete user click (matches GuiControlBar), read-only, skipped if AudioBank absent. NOT per-frame (no tight-loop audio).

bug_pattern_firewall.#9_runInBackground: NO coroutine, NO WaitForSeconds, NO always-on background timer/heartbeat. Refresh is frame-driven Update (shares AutoScreenshotter runInBackground path under qa.py). No new background-only timer introduced.
